Method of Attack: spear-phishing emails exploiting popular subjects such as invoices or postal delivery notifications
pushing a wide range of first-stage malware
maintaining access to compromised networks for three to twelve months
targeting operator accounts controlling significant sums of money
using stolen credentials to transfer funds into Channel User accounts and then to subscriber accounts
withdrawing stolen money as cash through an extensive network of ATMs over holidays or weekends
Discoverer: Criminal Investigative Division of the United States Secret Service
Impacted Systems: at least three banks in French-speaking African countries
